label: Ghost NAMES and Ghost Flesh
from: GHOST FLESH & FORGOTTEN NAMES — the Surviving Hounds, Atlas and Leviathan, Valentine's confession
to: GHOST NAMES AND GHOST FLESH. Atlas returns, EDEN COMES OUT OF THE WOODWORK, AND DIA IS BORN
note:
THE TITLE WAS INVERTED AND MISWORDED. It is GHOST NAMES AND GHOST FLESH — names first.

ATLAS RETURNS. EDEN COMES OUT OF THE WOODWORK. The Archive had been carrying ATLAS AND LEVIATHAN as a pair of returning names without knowing that Leviathan is EDEN, or that this is the arc where she stops being a codename in a lab note and becomes a person in the room.

AND DIA IS BORN HERE. Eden's LAST transformation, made after she took Last Kiss — the antidote she named herself. Arc 8 contains both the emergence of the woman and the final thing she ever made.

ADOPTED: CYRENA AND DESTINY, following Arc 7's Lucky Hammer appearance, where they were fucking and Sera sighed and BRYN SAID NOT YET. Arc 8 is when it stops being not yet.

GWEN AND AKANE MOVE FROM CAMEO INTO PRESENCE — Gwen's farming side quest for a woman who sends prospective suitors on side quests belongs here.

FIRST CAMEOS: SAGE, and KATHERINE AND WYNTER.

BIRTHDAYS: yes, and IVY'S IS CELEBRATED FOR CERTAIN.

AND THE PANDORA MATERIAL IS GONE FROM THIS ARC, because she wanted to be with Jade earlier than Arc 8. ARCS 7 AND 8 ARE UNDER REWRITE AND EVERYTHING IN BOTH IS MARKED PROVISIONAL.
